card.line: Patmos is a small, rocky island in the Aegean Sea where John was living when he received the vision written down in the book of Revelation.

moments.title: John on Patmos
moments.text: John calls himself a brother and partner in the troubles, the kingdom, and the patient endurance found in Jesus. He says he was on the island of Patmos because of the word of God and his testimony about Jesus.

moments.title: A voice like a trumpet
moments.text: On the Lord's day, John was in the Spirit and heard a loud voice behind him like a trumpet. The voice told him to write what he saw on a scroll and send it to seven churches.

moments.title: One like the Son of Man
moments.text: John turned and saw seven golden lampstands. Among them stood One like the Son of Man, with white hair, eyes like blazing fire, and a voice like the roar of many waters.
